_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/copies/test_enters_as_exiled_copy.py. t_meac_mimic is The Mimeoplasm's line on a printed 0/0: a self_enters_as_copy replacement whose as_enters effects may exile exactly two creature cards from any graveyards, bound as 'exiled'; it enters as a copy of one of them ('copying' is that binding) with +1/+1 counters equal to the power of the other. t_meac_ogre is a 4/3 flier and t_meac_imp a 1/1, the two models; t_meac_star is a */3 whose CDA counts the Forests its owner controls, so its power in exile is a number. t_meac_altar is a noncreature card in a graveyard, which may not be exiled.

cards.name: Test Mimic Ooze
cards.oracle_text: As Test Mimic Ooze enters, you may exile two creature cards from graveyards. If you do, it enters as a copy of one of those cards with a number of additional +1/+1 counters on it equal to the power of the other card.

then.prompt: Exile two creature cards from graveyards?
